description: List published articles on hellobooks.ai — head-to-head compare pages and curated flagship blog posts. Filter by country, tag or free-text query. Use this when a user asks "do you have a blog/article about X?".

country.description: ISO country code or "global". Returns articles whose countryRelevance matches OR is "global". Omit to return everything.

query.description: Free-text query — substring-matched against the title, excerpt and tags of each article. e.g. "QuickBooks alternative" or "audit trail".

tag.description: Single tag to filter on (case-insensitive substring match against the article tag list). e.g. "gst", "1099", "tally".

name: list_articles
